name: claim-free-batch
title: Claim permanently free assets in bulk
summary: Find permanently free assets published since a date and add them to the library in one batch

inputs.name: Since
inputs.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD; compute it

steps.why: List the candidates and which are already owned
steps.check: show the rows with owned:false and ask the user before claiming

steps.why: Claim every result with one Fab session; owned ones answer already_owned, paid ones are never claimed
steps.check: meta.claimed, already_owned, skipped_paid, skipped_promo_only, failed; read each result's ok, not just the exit code

on_error.auth_required: The batch stopped (stopped.at_uid): run fabcli auth login, then re-run; claimed ones answer already_owned
on_error.rate_limited: The batch stopped: wait about 30 s and re-run

notes: To claim only the assets the user chose, use claim-batch --uids a,b,c instead of the pipe.
skipped_promo_only rows are Limited Time Free promos: claim them with playbook claim-promos.
A successful claim clears the library cache, so later library reads see the new assets.
